instagram.caption:
The overflow you told yourself was free.
The Guest Dresser in the Guest Bedroom. Somewhere a guest can unpack, so they stop living out of a half open suitcase on the floor.

What done looks like:
1. The top two drawers completely empty and lined
2. The lower drawers holding spare linens folded to one uniform footprint with a label on the inside front edge
3. An anti-tip strap fixed to the wall
4. The dresser top carrying a lamp or a mirror

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success guest dresser.
